title: h3.c: MiniMax H3 video generation on Apple Silicon in pure C and Metal
description:
h3.c runs MiniMax's H3 video model on Apple Silicon in plain C and Metal, no Python and no PyTorch anywhere, from the Redis author. It generates video with synced stereo audio from a prompt, from first and last frame anchors, or from ordered image, video and audio references. You’ll still need the MiniMax-H3 checkpoint, FFmpeg, and substantial unified memory, with optimization focused on M3 Max and M5 Max. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/antirez/h3.c
